sentences.en: We saw a fish splashing in the water.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一条鱼在水里溅起水花。

sentences.en: The passing car splashed muddy water on me.
sentences.zh: 一辆经过的汽车把泥水溅到我身上。

sentences.en: A passing car splashed my coat with water.
sentences.zh: 一辆经过的汽车把水溅到了我的外套上。
